summary.text: Change Failure Rate is the percentage of changes that failed, were rolled back, or required emergency remediation (provisional definition, pending validation). The illustrative reading for the week ending 25 October 2026 is 14.1%, and the week ending 18 October is 12.6%. Green is 5% and amber is 10%; lower is better. The result is red because the rate is above 10%. The supplied scenario states that the metric went red on 18 October. For CTL-CM-02, failed change is above the control tolerance. Owner function on the illustrative register is Technology Risk.

whatChanged: The illustrative weekly rate is 14.1% for the week ending 25 October, and 12.6% for the week ending 18 October. Both are above the 10% amber threshold. The supplied scenario states the metric went red on 18 October.
whyItMatters: CTL-CM-02 treats change failure above 10% as red. The named signal is a Payments release associated with rollbacks. That release is a change signal, not an organizational hotspot. No group breakdown was supplied.
